adhkar.text_arabic: وَأَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ بِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَیِّدُنَا آدَمُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَیِّدُنَا نُوحٌ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَیِّدُنَا هُودٌ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَیِّدُنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَیِّدُنَا صَالِحٌ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَیِّدُنَا يُونُسُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَیِّدُنَا أَيُّوبُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَیِّدُنَا يَعْقُوبُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَیِّدُنَا يُوسُفُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَیِّدُنَا مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَیِّدُنَا هَارُونُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَیِّدُنَا شُعَيْبٌ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَیِّدُنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَیِّدُنَا دَاوُودُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَیِّدُنَا سُلَيْمَانُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَیِّدُنَا زَكَرِيَّا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَیِّدُنَا يَحْیَی عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَیِّدُنَا أَرْمِيَاءُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَیِّدُنَا شَعْيَاءُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَیِّدُنَا إِلْيَاسُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَیِّدُنَا الْيَسَعُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَیِّدُنَا ذُو الْكِفْلِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَیِّدُنَا يُوشَعُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَیِّدُنَا عِيسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَیِّدُنَا مُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَعَلَى جَمِيعِ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالمُرْسَلِينَ: أَنْ تُصَلِّي عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ نَّبِيِّكَ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَهُ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَكُونَ السَّمَاءُ مَبْنِيَّةً، وَالأَرْضُ مَدْحِيَّةً، وَالجِبَالُ مُرْسَاةً، وَالبِحَارُ مُجْرَاةً، وَالعُيُونُ مُنْفَجِرَةً، وَالأَنْهَارُ مُنْهَمِرَةً، وَالشَّمْسُ مُضْحِيَةً، وَالقَمَرُ مُضِيئًا، وَالكَوَاكِبُ مُسْتَنِيرَةً، كُنْتَ حَيْثُ كُنْتَ لَا يَعْلَمُ أَحَدٌ حَيْثُ كُنْتَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ.
adhkar.translation: And I ask You, O Allah, by the Names by which our Master Adam, peace be upon him, prayed to You; by the Names by which our Master Noah (Nūḥ), peace be upon him, prayed to You; by the Names by which our Master Hūd, peace be upon him, prayed to You; by the Names by which our Master Abraham (Ibrāhīm), peace be upon him, prayed to You; by the Names by which our Master Ṣāliḥ, peace be upon him, prayed to You; by the Names by which our Master Jonah (Yūnus), peace be upon him, prayed to You; by the Names by which our Master Job (Ayyūb), peace be upon him, prayed to You; by the Names by which our Master Jacob (Ya'qūb), peace be upon him, prayed to You, and by the Names by which our Master Joseph (Yūsuf), peace be upon him, prayed to You; by the Names by which our Master Moses (Mūsā), peace be upon him, prayed to You; by the Names by which our Master Aaron (Hārūn), peace be upon him, prayed to You; by the Names by which our Master Shu'ayb, peace be upon him, prayed to You; by the Names by which our Master Ishmael (Ismā'īl), peace be upon him, prayed to You; by the Names by which our Master David (Dā'ūd), peace be upon him, prayed to You; by the Names by which our Master Solomon (Sulaymān), peace be upon him, prayed to You; by the Names by which our Master Zachariah (Zakariyyā), peace be upon him, prayed to You; by the Names by which our Master John (Yaḥyā), peace be upon him, prayed to You; by the Names by which our Master Jeremiah (Armiyā'), peace be upon him, prayed to You; by the Names by which our Master Isaiah (Sha'iyā'), peace be upon him, prayed to You; by the Names by which our Master Elias (Ilyās), peace be upon him, prayed to You; by the Names by which [Jacob's son] our Master Esau (al-Yasa'), peace be upon him, prayed to You; by the Names by which our Master Dhū al-Kifl, peace be upon him, prayed to You; by the Names by which our Master Joshua (Yūsha'), peace be upon him, prayed to You; by the Names by which our Master Jesus son of Mary ('Īsā ibn Maryam), peace be upon him, prayed to You; and by the Names by which our Master Muḥammad, may Allah exalt and preserve him and all the Prophets and Emissaries, prayed to You – to exalt our Master Muḥammad, Your Prophet, by the sum of all that You created before the sky was built, the Earth was spread out, the mountains were anchored down, the seas were set in motion, springs were made to gush and rivers to flow, the sun was made to blaze and the moon to shine, and the stars were illuminated; [when] You were wherever You were; and no one knows where You were but You, who are the One and Only and have no partner.
adhkar.transliteration: Wa asʾaluka Allāhumma bil asmāʾillatī daʿāka bihā sayyidunā Ādamu ʿalayhi salām, wa bil asmāʾillatī daʿāka bihā sayyidunā Nuḥun ʿalayhi salām, wa bil asmāʾillatī daʿāka bihā sayyidunā Hūdun ʿalayhi salām, wa bil asmāʾillatī daʿāka bihā sayyidunā Ibrāhīmu ʿalayhi salām, wa bil asmāʾillatī daʿāka bihā sayyidunā Ṣāliḥun ʿalayhi salām, wa bil asmāʾillatī daʿāka bihā sayyidunā Yūnusu ʿalayhi salām, wa bil asmāʾillatī daʿāka bihā sayyidunā Ayyūbu ʿalayhi salām, wa bil asmāʾillatī daʿāka bihā sayyidunā Yaʿqūbu ʿalayhi salām, wa bil asmāʾillatī daʿāka bihā sayyidunā Yūsufu ʿalayhi salām, wa bil asmāʾillatī daʿāka bihā sayyidunā Mūsā ʿalayhi salām, wa bil asmāʾillatī daʿāka bihā sayyidunā Harūnu ʿalayhi salām, wa bil asmāʾillatī daʿāka bihā sayyidunā Shuʿaybun ʿalayhi salām, wa bil asmāʾillatī daʿāka bihā sayyidunā Ismāʿīlu ʿalayhi salām, wa bil asmāʾillatī daʿāka bihā sayyidunā Dāwūdu ʿalayhi salām, wa bil asmāʾillatī daʿāka bihā sayyidunā Sulaymānu ʿalayhi salām, wa bil asmāʾillatī daʿāka bihā sayyidunā Zakariyyāʾ ʿalayhi salām, wa bil asmāʾillatī daʿāka bihā sayyidunā Yaḥyā ʿalayhi salām, wa bil asmāʾillatī daʿāka bihā sayyidunā Armiyāʾu ʿalayhi salām, wa bil asmāʾillatī daʿāka bihā sayyidunā Shaʿyāʾu alayhi salām, wa bil asmāʾillatī daʿāka bihā sayyidunā Ilyāsu ʿalayhi salām, wa bil asmāʾillatī daʿāka bihā sayyidunā Alyasʿu ʿalayhi salām, wa bil asmāʾillatī daʿāka bihā sayyidunā Dhul kifli ʿalayhi salām, wa bil asmāʾillatī daʿāka bihā sayyidunā Yūshaʿu ʿalayhi salām, wa bil asmāʾillatī daʿāka bihā sayyidunā ʿĪsā ʿalayhi salām, wa bil asmāʾillatī daʿāka bihā sayyidunā Muḥammadun ṣallAllāhu ʿalayhi wa sallama wa ʿalā jamīʿin nabiyyīna wal mursalīna: An tuṣallī ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin nabiyyika ʿadada ma khalaqtahu min qabli an takūnas samāʾu mabniyyatan, wal arḍu madḥiyyatan, wal jibālu mursātan, wal biḥāru mujrātan, wal ʿuyūnu munfajiratan, wal anhāru munhamiratan, wash shamsu muḍḥiyatan, wal qamaru muḍīʾan, wal kawākibu mustanīratan, kunta ḥaythu kunta lā yaʿlamu aḥadun ḥaythu kunta illā anta waḥdaka lā sharīka laka.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ حِلْمِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ عِلْمِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ كَلِمَاتِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ نِعْمَتِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِلْءَ سَمَاوَاتِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِلْءَ أَرْضِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِلْءَ عَرْشِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ زِنَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا جَرَى بِهِ القَلَمُ فِي أُمِّ الكِتَابِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ فِي سَبْعِ سَمَاوَاتِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَنْتَ خَالِقٌ فِيهِنَّ إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad by the sum of Your [acts of] forbearance, and exalt our Master Muḥammad by the amount of Your Knowledge, and exalt our Master Muḥammad by the sum of Your Words, and exalt our Master Muḥammad by the sum of Your bounties, and exalt our Master Muḥammad to the fullness of Your Heavens, and exalt our Master Muḥammad to the fullness of Your Earth, and exalt our Master Muḥammad to the fullness of Your Throne, and exalt our Master Muḥammad by the weight of Your Throne, and exalt our Master Muḥammad by the sum of all that the Pen [of the Divine Decree] has written in the Mother of the Book, and exalt our Master Muḥammad by the sum of all that You have created in Your Seven Heavens, and exalt our Master Muḥammad by the sum of all that You shall create in them until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times over each day.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada ḥilmika, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada ʿilmika, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada kalimātika, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada niʿmatika, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin milʾa samāwātika, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin milʾa arḍika, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muhammadin milʾa ʿarshika, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin zinata ʿarshika, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada mā jara bihil qalamu fī ummil kitāb, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada mā khalaqta fī sabʿi samāwātika, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada mā anta khāliqun fīhinna ilā yawmil qiyāmati fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ كُلِّ قَطْرَةٍ قَطَرَتْ مِنْ سَمَاوَاتِكَ إِلَى أَرْضِكَ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad by the sum of every drop of rain that has fallen from Your Heavens to Your Earth, from the Day You created this world to the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times over each day.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada kulli qaṭratin qaṭarat min samāwātika ilā arḍika, min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmati fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ يُسَبِّحُكَ وَيُهَلِّلُكَ وَيُكَبِّرُكَ وَيُعَظِّمُكَ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad by the sum of those who have glorified You, declared Your unity, magnified You, and extolled You, from the Day You created this world to the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times over each day.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada man yusabbiḥuka wa yuhalliluka, wa yukabbiruka wa yuʿaẓẓimuka, min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmati fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ أَنْفَاسِهِمْ وَأَلْفَاظِهِمْ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ كُلِّ نَسَمَةٍ خَلَقْتَهَا فِيهِمْ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad by the sum of their breaths and moments (other copies have 'breaths and words'); and exalt our Master Muḥammad by the sum of every exhalation You have created in them, from the Day You created this world to the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times over each day.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada anfāsihim wa alfāẓihim, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada kulli nasamatin khalaqtahā fihim, min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmati fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ السَّحَابِ الجَارِيَةِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الرِّيَاحِ الذَّارِيَةِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad by the number of the moving clouds, and exalt our Master Muḥammad by the number of every sweeping wind, from the Day You created this world to the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times over each day.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadadas saḥābil jāriyah, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadadar riyāḥidh dhāriyati, min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmati fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا هَبَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الرِّيَاحُ وَحَرَّكَتْهُ مِنَ الأَغْصَانِ وَالأَشْجَارِ، وَالأَوْرَاقِ وَالثِّمَارِ، وَجَمِيعِ مَا خَلَقْتَ عَلَى أَرْضِكَ، وَمَا بَيْنَ سَمَاوَاتِكَ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad by the sum of every branch, tree, leaf, and fruit the winds blow and stir; and of all that You have created on Your Earth and between Your Heavens, from the Day You created this world to the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times over each day.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada mā habbat ʿalayhir riyāḥu wa ḥarrakathu minal aghṣāni wal ashjāri, wal awrāqi wath thimāri, wa jamīʿi mā khalaqta ʿalā arḍika, wa mā bayna samāwātika, min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmati fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ نُجُومِ السَّمَاءِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad by the sum of the stars in the sky, from the Day You created this world to the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times over each day.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada nujūmis samāʾi, min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmati fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِّلْءَ أَرْضِكَ، مِمَّا حَمَلَتْ وَأَقَلَّتْ مِنْ قُدْرَتِكَ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad to the fullness of Your Earth and of what it bears and carries from Your Omnipotent Power.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada milʾa arḍika, mim mā ḥamalat wa aqallat min qudratika.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ فِي سَبْعِ بِحَارِكَ، مِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُ عِلْمَهُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَمَا أَنْتَ خَالِقُهُ فِيهَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad by the sum of all that You have created in Your Seven Seas that is known to none but You, and of all that You will create in them until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times over each day.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muhammad ʿadada mā khalaqta fī sabʿi biḥārika, mimmā lā yaʿlamu illā anta, wa mā anta khāliquhu fīhā ilā yawmil qiyāmati fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مِلْءِ سَبْعِ بِحَارِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ زِنَةَ سَبْعِ بِحَارِكَ، مِمَّا حَمَلَتْ وَأَقَلَّتْ مِنْ قُدْرَتِكَ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad to the fullness of Your Seven Seas; exalt our Master Muḥammad by the sum of the weight of Your Seven Seas in that which they bear and carry from Your Omnipotent Power.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muhammad ʿadada milʾi sabʿi biḥārika, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin zinata sabʿi biḥārika, mimmā ḥamalat wa aqqalat min qudratika.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ أَمْوَاجِ بِحَارِكَ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad by the sum of the waves on Your Seas, from the Day You created this world to the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times over each day.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada amwāji biḥārika, min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmati fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الرَّمْلِ وَالحَصَى فِي مُسْتَقَرِّ الأَرَضِينَ وَسَهْلِهَا وَجِبَالِهَا، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad by the sum of the grains of sand and tiny stones in the inhabited regions, the plains, and the hills of the Earths, from the Day You created this world to the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times over each day.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma waṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin adadar ramli wal ḥaṣā, fī mustaqaril araḍīna wa sahlihā wa jibālihā min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmati fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ اضْطِرَابِ المِيَاهِ العَذْبَةِ وَالمِلْحَةِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَهُ عَلَى جَدِيدِ أَرْضِكَ فِي مُسْتَقَرِّ الأَرَضِينَ شَرْقِهَا وَغَرْبِهَا سَهْلِهَا وَجِبَالِهَا وَأَوْدِيَتِهَا وَطَرِيقِهَا وَعَامِرِهَا وَغَامِرِهَا إِلَى سَائِرِ مَا خَلَقْتَهُ عَلَيْهَا وَمَا فِیهَا مِنْ حَصَاةٍ وَمَدَرٍ وَحَجَرٍ مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad as many [times] as [there is] turbulence in salt and fresh water, from the day You created this world to the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times over each day. And exalt our Master Muḥammad by the sum of all that You have created on the surface of Your Earths, in its inhabited regions, in the East and the West, plains and mountains, river valleys and pathways, flourishing lands and wastelands; and of all else that You have created on it and in it by way of tiny stones, clods, and rocks, from the Day You created this world to the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times over each day.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma waṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadadaḍṭirābil miyāhil ʿadhbati wal milḥati, min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmati fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada mā khalaqtahū ʿalā jadīdi arḍika fī mustaqarril arḍīna sharqihā wa gharbihā sahlihā wa jibālihā wa awdiyatihā wa ṭarīqihā wa ʿāmirihā īlā sāʾiri mā fīhā min yawmin khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmah fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ عَدَدَ نَبَاتِ الأَرْضِ مِنْ قِبْلَتِهَا وَشَرْقِهَا وَغَرْبِهَا، وَسَهْلِهَا وَجِبَالِهَا وَأَوْدِيَتِهَا، وَأَشْجَارِهَا وَثِمَارِهَا، وَأَوْرَاقِهَا وَزُرُوعِهَا، وَجَمِيعِ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْ نَبَاتِهَا وَبَرَكَاتِهَا، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad the Prophet, by the sum of the plants on Earth – in the South, East, and West of it – its plains and mountains, river valleys, trees, fruits, leaves, and crops, and [as many as] all the plants and blessings that grow upon it, from the Day You created this world to the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times over each day.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin nabiyyi ʿadada nabātil arḍi min qiblatihā wa sharqihā wa gharbihā wa sahlihā wa jibālihā wa awdiyatihā wa ashjārihā wa thimārihā wa awrāqiha wa zurūʿiha wa jamīʿi mā yakhruju min nabātiha wa barakātiha min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmati fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ مِنَ الجِنِّ وَالإِنْسِ وَالشَّيَاطِينِ، وَمَا أَنْتَ خَالِقُهُ مِنْهُمْ إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad by the sum of the jinn, humans, and devils You have created and will create until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times over each day.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma waṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada mā khalaqta minal jinni wal insi wash shayāṭīni, wa mā anta khāliquhu minhum ilā yawmil qiyāmati fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ كُلِّ شَعْرَةٍ فِي أَبْدَانِهِمْ وَفِي وُجُوهِهِمْ وَعَلَى رُءُوسِهِمْ، مُنْذُ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad by the sum of the follicles of hair on their bodies, faces, and heads, from when You created this world to the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times over each day.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma waṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada kulli shaʿratin fī abdānihim wa fī wujūhihim wa ʿalā ruʾūsihim, mundhu khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmati fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ خَفَقَانِ الطَّيْرِ وَطَيَرَانِ الجِنِّ وَالشَّیَاطِينِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad as many [times] as birds flap their wings and jinn and devils fly, from the Day You created this world to the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times over each day.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma waṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada khafaqāniṭ ṭayri wa ṭayarānil jinni wash shayāṭīni, min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmati fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ كُلِّ بَهِيمَةٍ خَلَقْتَهَا عَلَى وَجْهِ أَرْضِكَ مِنْ صَغِيرٍ أَوْ كَبِيرٍ، فِي مَشَارِقِ الأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبِهَا، مِنْ إِنْسِهَا وَجِنِّهَا، وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُ عِلْمَهُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad by the sum of the beasts that You have created on the surface of Your Earth, both great and small, in the East of the world and in the West, and all its mankind and jinn, and all that is known to none but You, from the Day You created this world to the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times over each day.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada kulli bahīmatin khalaqtahā ʿalā wajhi arḍika min ṣaghīrin wa kabīrin, fī mashāriqil arḍi wa maghāribihā, min insihā wa jinnihā, wa mimmā lā yaʿlamu ʿilmahu illā anta, min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmati fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ خُطَاهُمْ عَلَى وَجْهِ الأَرْضِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad by the number of steps they take on the face of the Earth, from the Day You created this world to the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times over each day.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada khuṭāhum ʿalā wajhil arḍi, min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmati fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ يُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ القَطْرِ وَالمَطَرِ وَالنَّبَاتِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad by the sum of those who have exalted him, and exalt our Master Muḥammad by the sum of those who have not exalted him; exalt our Master Muḥammad by the sum of the raindrops, rainfalls, and plants; and exalt our Master Muḥammad by the sum of all [existing] things.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada man yuṣalli ʿalayhi, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada man lam yuṣalli ʿalayhi, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadadal qaṭri wal maṭari wannabāti, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada kulli shayʾ.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ في اللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ في النَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ في الآخِرَةِ وَالأُولَى، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ شَابًّا زَكِيًّا، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَهْلًا مَرْضِيًّا، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مُنْذُ كَانَ في المَهْدِ صَبِيًّا، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ حَتَّى لَا يَبْقَى مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ شَيْءٌ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad in the night when it enshrouds, exalt our Master Muḥammad in the daytime when it brightens, exalt our Master Muḥammad at the end and in the beginning, exalt our Master Muḥammad as a pure youth, exalt our Master Muḥammad as a well-pleasing mature man, and exalt our Master Muḥammad ever since he was an infant in the cradle. Exalt our Master Muḥammad until nothing remains [undone] by way of exaltation.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin fīl layli idhā yaghsha, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin fin nahāri idha tajalla, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin fīl ākhirati walʾūla, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin shābban zakiyya, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin kahlan marḍiyya, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin mundhu kāna fīl mahdi ṣabiyya, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ḥatta lā yabqa minaṣ ṣalāti shayʾ.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَأَعْطِ سَیِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا المَقَامَ المَحْمُودَ الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ، الَّذِي إِذَا قَالَ صَدَّقْتَهُ، وَإِذَا سَأَلَ أَعْطَيْتَهُ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, grant our Master Muḥammad the Most Praised Station which You have promised him, wherein when he speaks You prove him truthful, and when he asks You give to him.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma wa aʿṭi sayyidanā Muḥammadanil maqāmal maḥmūd alladhī waʿadtahu alladhī idhā qāla ṣaddaqtahu, wa idhā saʾala aʿṭaytahu.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَأَعْظِمْ بُرْهَانَهُ، وَشَرِّفْ بُنْيَانَهُ، وَأَبْلِجْ حُجَّتَهُ، وَبَيِّنْ فَضِيلَتَهُ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, make his Argument (burhān) mighty, ennoble his stature (bunyān), cause his Proof (ḥujja) to shine, make his superiority evident.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma wa aʿẓim burhānahu, wa sharrif bunyānahu, wa ablij ḥujjatahu, wa bayyin faḍīlatahu.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَتَقَبَّلْ شَفَاعَتَهُ فِي أُمَّتِهِ، وَاسْتَعْمِلْنَا بِسُنَّتِهِ، وَتَوَفَّنَا عَلَى مِلَّتِهِ، وَاحْشُرْنَا فِي زُمْرَتِهِ، وَتَحْتَ لِوَائِهِ، وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ رُفَقَائِهِ، وَأَوْرِدْنَا حَوْضَهُ، وَاسْقِنَا بِكَأْسِهِ، وَانْفَعْنَا بِمَحَبَّتِهِ، اللَّهُمَّ آمِينَ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, accept his intercession for his Nation. Make us practise his Sunna, let us die in his religion, resurrect us in his company and beneath his Banner, and make us among his companions. Water us at his Celestial Pool, and let us drink from his Cup; and benefit us through his love. O Allah, Amen.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma wa taqabbal shafāʿatahu fī ummatihi. wastaʿmilnā bisunnatihi, wa tawaffanā ʿalā millatihi, waḥshurnā fī zumratihi, wa taḥta liwāʾihi, wajʿalnā min rufaqāʾihi, wa awridnā ḥawḍahu, wasqinā bi kaʾsihi, wanfaʿnā bimaḥabbatihi, Allāhumma āmīn.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِأَسْمَائِكَ الَّتِي دَعَوْتُكَ بِهَا أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا وَصَفْتُ، وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُ عِلْمَهُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَأَنْ تَرْحَمَنِي وَتَتُوبَ عَلَيَّ وَتُعَافِيَنِي مِنْ جَمِيعِ البَلَاءِ وَالبَلْوَاءِ، وَأَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي وَتَرْحَمَ المُؤْمِنِينَ وَالمُؤْمِنَاتِ، وَالمُسْلِمِينَ وَالمُسْلِمَاتِ، الأَحْيَاءَ مِنْهُمْ وَالأَمْوَاتَ، وَأَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِعَبْدِكَ (فُلَانِ بْنِ فُلَانٍ) المُذْنِبِ الخَاطِئِ الضَّعِيفِ، وَأَنْ تَتُوبَ عَلَيْهِ، إِنَّكَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ، اللَّهُمَّ آمِينَ، يَا رَبَّ العَالَمِینَ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You, o Allah, by Your Names by which I have called on You, to exalt our Master Muḥammad, by the number of all that I have described and of that which is known to none but You; and to have mercy on me and relent towards me, and to keep me free from all trials and tribulations; and to forgive me, and to have mercy on the believing men and women and the Muslim men and women, the living among them and the dead. And that You forgive [add the appropriate name(s) for the reader, reciter, or listener] the sinful, the offender, the weak, and relent towards him [or her]. You are Much-Forgiving, Most Merciful. O Allah, Amen, O Lord of the Worlds.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma wa asʾaluka bi asmāʾikallatī daʿawtuka bihā an tuṣallī ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada mā waṣaftu, wa mimmā lā yaʿlamu ʿilmahu illā anta, an tarḥamanī wa tatūba ʿalayya wa tuʿāfiyanī min jamīʿil balāʾi wal balwaʾi, wa an taghfiralī wa tarḥamal muʾminīna wal muʾmināti, wal muslimīna wal muslimāt, al aḥyāʾa minhum wal amwāta, wa an taghfira li ʿabdika (fulān ibni fulān) almudhnibil khāṭiʾiḍ ḍaʿīfi, wa an tatūba ʿalayhi, innaka ghafūrur raḥīm, Allāhumma āmīna, yā rabbal ʿālamīn.

adhkar.text_arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: (مَنْ قَرَأَ هَذِهِ الصَّلَاةَ مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَهُ ثَوَابَ حَجَّةٍ مَقْبُولَةٍ، وَثَوَابَ مَنْ أَعْتَقَ رَقَبَةً مِنْ وَلَدِ إِسمَاعِيلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، فَيَقُولُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: يَا مَلَائِكَتي هَذَا عَبْدٌ مِنْ عِبَادِي أَكْثَرَ الصَّلَاةَ عَلَى حَبِيبِي مُحَمَّدٍ، فَوَعِزَّتِي وَجَلَالِي وَجُودِي وَمَجْدِي وَارْتِفَاعِي لَأُعْطِيَنَّهُ بِكُلِّ حَرْفٍ صَلَّى بِهِ قَصْرًا فِي الجَنَّةِ، وَلَيَأْتِيَنِّي يَوْمَ القِيَامَةِ تَحْتَ لِوَاءِ الحَمْدِ، نُورُ وَجْهِهِ كَالْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ البَدْرِ، وَكَفُّهُ فِي كَفِّ حَبِيبِي مُحَمَّدٍ). هَذَا لِمَنْ قَالَهَا كُلَّ يَوْمِ جُمُعَةٍ، لَهُ هَذَا الفَضْلُ، واللَّهُ ذُو الفَضْلِ العَظِيمِ. وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ:
adhkar.translation: Said the Emissary of Allah, may Allah exalt and preserve him: 'Whoever recites this [form of] exaltation once, Allah will record for him the reward of an accepted Hajj and the reward of liberating a slave from the descendants of Ishmael, peace be upon him. Allah will say, Blessed and Exalted is He: "O My angels, this is one of My servants who has exalted abundantly My Beloved Muḥammad, so by My Glory, My Majesty, My Generosity, My Splendour, and My Sublimity, I shall assuredly bestow upon him, for every letter of exaltation, a palace in Paradise; he shall certainly come to me on the Day of Resurrection beneath the Banner of Praise, the light of his face being like that of the moon on the night when it is full; and his hand shall be in the hand of My Beloved Muḥammad."' This is for whoever says it every Friday; he shall have this grace, 'and Allah is the Possessor of Immense Grace.' Another narration has:
adhkar.transliteration: Qāla rasūluLlāhi ṣallAllāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam: man qaraʾa hadhihiṣ ṣalāta marratan wāḥidatan katabAllāhu lahu thawāba ḥajattin maqbūlatin, wa thawāba man ʿataqa raqabatan min waladi ʿIsmāʿīla alayhis salām, fa yaqūLlāhu taʿāla: yā malāʾikatī hadha ʿabdun min ʿibādi aktharaṣ ṣalāta ʿalā ḥabībi Muḥammadin, fa waʿizzatī wa jalālī wa jūdī wa majdī wa irtifāʿī bikulli ḥarfin ṣallā bihi qaṣran fīl jannati, wa layaʾtiyannī yawmal qiyāmati taḥta liwāʾil ḥamdi, nūru wajhihi kalqamari laylatal badri wa kaffuhu fi kaffi ḥabībi Muḥammad. Hadha liman qālahā kulla yawmi jumuʿa. Lahu hadhal faḍlu wAllahu dhul faḍlil aẓīm. Wa fī riwaya.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ مَا حَمَلَ كُرْسِيُّكَ مِنْ عَظَمَتِكَ وَقُدْرَتِكَ وَجَلَالِكَ وَبَهَائِكَ وَسُلْطَانِكَ، وَبِحَقِّ اسْمِكَ المَخْزُونِ المَكْنُونِ الَّذِي سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، وَأَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، وَاسْتَأثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ. وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِي إِذَا دُعِيتَ بِهِ أَجَبْتَ، وَإِذَا سُئِلْتَ بِهِ أَعْطَيْتَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِي وَضَعْتَهُ عَلَى اللَّيْلِ فَأَظْلَمَ، وَعَلَى النَّهَارِ فَاسْتَنَارَ، وَعَلَى السَّمَاوَاتِ فَاسْتَقَلَّتْ، وَعَلَى الأَرْضِ فَاسْتَقَرَّتْ، وَعَلَى الجِبَالِ فَأَرْسَتْ، وَعَلَى الصَّعْبَةِ فَذَلَّتْ، وَعَلَى مَاءِ السَّمَاءِ فَسَكَبَتْ، وَعَلَى مَاءِ السَّحَابِ فَأَمْطَرَتْ. وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِمَا سَأَلَكَ بِهِ سَیِّدُنَا مُحَمَّدٌ نَّبِيُّكَ. وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِمَا سَأَلَكَ بِهِ سَیِّدُنَا آدَمُ نَبِيُّكَ. وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِمَا سَأَلَكَ بِهِ أَنْبِيَاؤُكَ وَرُسُلُكَ، وَمَلَائِکَتُكَ المُقَرَّبُونَ، صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَجْمَعِينَ. وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِمَا سَأَلَكَ بِهِ أَهْلُ طَاعَتِكَ أَجْمَعِينَ، أَنْ تُصَلِّي عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَكُونَ السَّمَاءُ مَبْنِيَّةً، وَالأَرْضُ مَدْحِيَّةً، وَالجِبَالُ مَرْسِيَّةً، وَالعُيُونُ مُنْفَجِرَةً، وَالأَنْهَارُ مُنْهَمِرَةً، وَالشَّمْسُ مُضْحِيَّةً، وَالقَمَرُ مُضِيئًا، وَالكَوَاكِبُ مُنِيرَةً.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You by the right of that which Your Footstool carries by way of Your Might, Your Omnipotent Power, Your Majesty, Your Beauty, Your Splendour, and Your Sovereignty; and by the right of Your Hidden, Secret Name by which You have named Yourself, which You sent down in Your Scripture, and which You have made exclusive to Yourself in the knowledge of the Unseen, that You exalt our Master Muḥammad, Your Servant and Emissary; and I ask You by Your Name in response to which, if supplicated by it, You give, and if asked by which You bestow. O Allah, I ask You by the Name which You laid upon the night so that darkness fell; and upon the daytime so that it became light; and upon the Heavens so that they were raised aloft; and upon the Earth so that it became fixed in place; and upon the mountains so that they steadied [the Earth]; and upon the refractory so that it became pliant (dhallat); and upon the water in the sky so that it wept; and upon the clouds so that they rained. And I ask You by [all] that our Master Muḥammad, Your Prophet, asked You by. And I ask You by [all] that our Master Adam, Your Prophet, asked You by. And I ask You by [all] that Your Prophets and Your Emissaries asked You by, and the Angels brought near [to You] – may Allah exalt them all. And I ask You, by that which all the Folk devoted to obeying You asked You by, to exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad by the sum of [all] that You created before the sky was built, the Earth was spread out, springs were made to gush, rivers poured, the sun was made to blaze and the moon to shine, and the stars were illumined.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma inni asʾaluka biḥāqqi mā ḥamala kursiyyuka min ʿaẓamatika wa qudratika wa jalālika wa bahāʾika wa sulṭānika, wa biḥaqqismikal makhzūnil maknūnilladhi sammayta bihi nafsaka, wa anzaltahu fī kitābika, wastaʾtharta bihi fī ʿilmil ghaybi ʿindaka, an tuṣallī ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿabdika wa rasūlika, wa asʾaluka bismika alladhī idha duʿīta bihi ajabta, wa idha suʾilta bihi aʿṭayta, wa asʾaluka bismikalladhī wa ḍaʿtahu ʿalal layli fa aẓlama, wa ʿalan nahāri fastanāra, wa ʿalas samāwāti fastaqallat, wa ʿalal arḍi fastaqarrat, wa ʿalal jibāli faʾarasat, wa ʿalāṣ ṣaʿbati fadhallat, wa ʿalā māʾis samāʾi fasakabat, wa ʿalā māʾis saḥābi faʾamṭarat, wa asʾaluka bimā saʾalaka bihi sayyidinā Muḥammadun nabiyyuka, wa asʾaluka bimā saʾalaka bihi sayyidinā Ādamu nabiyyuka, wa asʾaluka bimā saʾalaka bihi anbiyāʾuka wa rusulika, wa malāʾikatukal muqarrabūna, ṣallAllāhu ʿalayhim ajmaʿīna, wa asʾaluka bimā saʾalak bihi ahlu ṭāʿatika ajmaʿīna, an tuṣallī ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada ma khalaqta min qabli an takūnas samāʾu mabniyyatan, wal arḍu madḥiyyatan, wal jibālu mursiyyatan, wal ʿuyūnu munfajiratan, wal anhāru munhamiratan, wash shamsu muḍḥiyatan, wal qamaru muḍiʾan, wal kawākibu munīrah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ عِلْمِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ حِلْمِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَحْصَاهُ اللَّوْحُ المَحْفُوظُ مِنْ عِلْمِكَ. اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا جَرَى بِهِ القَلَمُ فِي أُمِّ الكِتابِ عِنْدَكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِلْءَ سَمَاوَاتِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِلْءَ أَرْضِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِلْءَ مَا أَنْتَ خَالِقُهُ مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad by the sum of Your Knowledge. O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad by the sum of Your [acts of] forbearance, and exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad by the sum of whatever of Your Knowledge is recorded on the Preserved Tablet. O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad by the sum of what the Pen has moved to [write] in the Mother of the Book in Your keeping; And exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad to the fullness of Your Heavens, exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad to the fullness of Your Earth, and exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad by the sum of all that You create, from the Day You created this world to the Day of Resurrection.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada ʿilmika, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada ḥilmika, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muhammad wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada ma aḥṣāhul lawḥul maḥfūẓu min ʿilmika. Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada mā jarā bihil qalamu fī ummil kitābi ʿindaka, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin milʾa samāwātika, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin milʾa arḍika, wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin milʾa mā anta khāliquhu min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ صُفُوفِ المَلَائِکَةِ وَتَسْبِيحِهِمْ وَتَقْدِيسِهِمْ، وَتَحْمِيدِهِمْ وَتَمْجِيدِهِمْ، وَتَكْبِيرِهِمْ وَتَهْلِيلِهِمْ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad by the sum of the ranks of angels and of their glorification, sanctification, praise, laudation, magnification, and affirmation of Your Unique Divinity, from the Day You created this world to the Day of Resurrection.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada ṣufūfil malāʾikati wa tasbīḥihim wa taqdīsihim, wa taḥmīdihim wa tamjīdihim, wa takbīrihim wa taḥlīlihim, min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ السَّحَابِ الجَارِيَةِ، وَالرِّيَاحِ الذَّارِيَةِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad by the sum of the rolling clouds and the sweeping winds, from the Day You created this world to the Day of Resurrection.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadadas saḥābil jāriyati, war riyāḥidh dhāriyati, min yawmin khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ كُلِّ قَطْرَةٍ تَقْطُرُ مِنْ سَمَاوَاتِكَ إِلَى أَرْضِكَ، وَمَا تَقْطُرُ إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad by the sum of the raindrops that fall from Your Heavens to Your Earth, and of every drop that falls until the Day of Resurrection.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada kulli qaṭratin taqṭuru min samāwātika ilā arḍika wa mā taqṭuru ilā yawmil qiyāmah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا هَبَّتِ الرِّيَاحُ، وَعَدَدَ مَا تَحَرَّكَتِ الأَشْجَارُ وَالأَوْرَاقُ وَالزَّرْعُ، وَجَمِيعِ مَا خَلَقْتَ فِي قَرَارِ الحِفْظِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad by the sum of every stirring by the wind and every movement of trees, leaves, and crops, and of all that You have created within a guarded dwelling-place, from the Day You created this world to the Day of Resurrection.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada mahabbatir riyāḥu, wa ʿadada mā taḥarrakatil ashjāru wal awrāqu wazzarʿu, wa jamīʿi mā khalaqta fī qarāril ḥifẓi, min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ القَطْرِ وَالمَطَرِ وَالنَّبَاتِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad by the sum of all dewdrops, raindrops, and vegetation, from the Day You created this world to the Day of Resurrection.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadadal qaṭri wal maṭari wan nabāti, min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ النُّجُومِ فِي السَّمَاءِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad by the sum of the stars in the sky, from the Day You created this world to the Day of Resurrection.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadadan nujūmis samāʾi, min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ فِي بِحَارِكَ السَّبْعَةِ مِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُ عِلْمَهُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَمَا أَنْتَ خَالِقُهُ إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad by the sum of all You have created in Your Seven Seas, of which none but You has knowledge, and as much as all that You will create until the Day of Resurrection.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada ma khalaqta fī biḥārikas sabʿati mimmā lā yaʿlamu ʿilmahu illā anta, wa mā anta khāliquhu ilā yawmil qiyāmah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الرَّمْلِ وَالحَصَى، فِي مَشَارِقِ الأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبِهَا.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad by the sum of every grain of sand and tiny stone in the Eastern and Western parts of the Earth.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadadar ramli wal ḥaṣā, fī mashāriqil arḍi wa maghāribihā.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ مِنَ الجِنِّ وَالإِنْسِ، وَمَا أَنْتَ خَالِقُهُ إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad by the sum of every jinn and human being You have created and will create until the Day of Resurrection.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada mā khalaqta minal jinni wal insi, wa mā anta khāliquhu ilā yawmil qiyāmah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ أَنْفَاسِهِمْ وَأَلْفَاظِهِمْ وَأَلْحَاظِهِمْ مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad by the sum of their breaths, utterances, and glances, from the Day You created this world to the Day of Resurrection.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada anfāsihim wa alfāẓihim wa alḥāẓihim min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ طَيَرَانِ الجِنِّ وَالمَلَائِکَةِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad by the sum of the flights of the jinn and the angels, from the Day You created this world to the Day of Resurrection.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada ṭayarānil jinni wal malāʾikati, min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الطُّيُورِ وَالهَوَامِّ، وَعَدَدَ الوُحُوشِ وَالآكَامِ فِي مَشَارِقِ الأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبِهَا.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad by the sum of every bird, vermin, wild beast, and high hill in the Eastern and Western parts of the Earth.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muhammadin ʿadadaṭ ṭuyūri wal hawāmmi, wa ʿadadal wuḥūshi wal ākāmi fī mashāriqil arḍi wa maghāribihā.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الأَحْيَاءِ وَالأَمْوَاتِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad by the sum of the living and the dead.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada alahyāʾi wal amwāt.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَظْلَمَ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْلُ وَأَشْرَقَ عَلَيْهِ النَّهَارُ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad by the sum of all that the night has shrouded in darkness and the day has illuminated, from the day You created this world to the Day of Resurrection.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada ma aẓlama ʿalayhil laylu wa ashraqa ʿalayhin naharu, min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ يَمْشِي عَلَى رِجْلَيْنِ، وَمَنْ يَمْشِي عَلَى أَرْبَعٍ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad by the sum of all that walk on two legs and all that walk on four, from the day You created this world to the Day of Resurrection.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada man yamshi ala rijlayni, wa man yamshi ala arbaʿin, min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الجِنِّ وَالإِنْسِ وَالمَلَائِکَةِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad by the sum of the jinn, human beings, and angels who have exalted him, from the Day You created this world to the Day of Resurrection.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿadada man ṣalla ʿalayhi minal jinni wal insi wal malāʾikati, min yawmi khalaqtad dunyā ilā yawmil qiyāmah.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا يَجِبُ أَنْ يُّصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad as it is fitting for him to be exalted.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā yajibu an yuṣalla ʿalayhi.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا يَنْبَغِي أَنْ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad as he likes to be exalted [or, as he must be exalted].
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin kamā yanbaghi an yuṣalla ʿalayhi.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ حَتَّى لَا يَبْقَى شَيْءٌ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad and the Family of our Master Muḥammad until no exaltation of him remains [undone].
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ḥatta lā yabqa shayʾun minaṣ ṣalāti ʿalayhi.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الأَوَّلِينَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الآخِرِينَ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad above the first, and exalt our Master Muḥammad above the last.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin fīl awwalīna. Wa ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin fīl ākhirīn.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ في المَلَإِ الأَعْلَى إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ، مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ، لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا باللَّهِ العَلِيِّ العَظِيمِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, exalt our Master Muḥammad in the Heavenly Assembly until the Day of Reckoning. As Allah wills. There is no power but through Allah, the Exalted, the Immense.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin fīl malaʾil aʿlā ilā yawmid dīn, māshāʾAllāhu lā quwwata illā biLlāhil ʿaliyyil ʿaẓīm.
